text:
Predicates:
HeckCattle(x) ::: x are Heck cattle.
Aurochs(x) ::: x are aurochs.
Animals(x) ::: x are animals.
Resemble(x, y) ::: x resemble y.
Extinct(x) ::: x are extinct.
ArtificialSelection(x) ::: x is a form of artificial selection.
DomesticAnimals(x) ::: x are domestic animals.
SelectiveBreeding(x) ::: x is deliberate selective breeding.
Premises:
ArtificialSelection(breedingBack) ::: Breeding back is a form of artificial selection.
SelectiveBreeding(breedingBack) ::: Breeding back is a form of deliberate selective breeding.
DomesticAnimals(x) → SelectiveBreeding(x) ::: domestic animals are deliberately selectively bred.
HeckCattle(x) → Resemble(x, aurochs) ∧ Publish(x, 1920s) ::: Heck cattle were bred-back in the 1920s to resemble the aurochs.
HeckCattle(x) → Animals(x) ::: Heck cattle are animals.
Aurochs(x) → Animals(x) ::: Aurochs are animals.
∃x (Animals(x) ∧ Resemble(x, y) ∧ Extinct(y)) ::: Some animals to be bred-back resemble animals that are extinct.
Conclusion:
∃x (HeckCattle(x) ∧ ArtificialSelection(x)) ::: Some Heck cattle are artificially selected.
